entries.summary: Backend: Django 4.2 + DRF + SimpleJWT with apps organized under backend/apps/ (staff, analytics, users, schools, students, finance, etc.)
Frontend: React 18 + Vite + Material UI 5 + Redux Toolkit + React Router 6 + ApexCharts
Dashboard routing uses role-based lazy-loaded components via roleDashboards mapping in Dashboard.jsx
Analytics backend uses ViewSet with @action decorators for dashboard stats at /analytics/stats/

Staff model has: user, staff_id, employee_number, school, department, category, designation, employment_type, qualification, date_of_birth, gender, marital_status, date_joined, date_of_first_appointment, date_of_retirement, grade_level, step, salary, profile_photo, pension_pin, tax_id, bank_name, bank_account_number
User model extends AbstractUser with role-based access (Role.choices), email as USERNAME_FIELD
